subject: Request: Renewal terms exception & credit for Pioneer MedTech - urgent exec approval
messages:
From: Owen Leary <owen.leary@pioneer-medtech.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@pioneer-medtech.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal options - request for one-time credit and SLA language

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Our current contract with Redwood is up on July 15. We've been generally happy with the platform, but after a budget reforecast we need to reduce our spend and tighten vendor SLAs. Before we proceed with an internal renewal recommendation, procurement has asked if Redwood can offer: 1) a one-time credit equal to 15% of the annual committed spend applied to Year 2, 2) a 12-month term reset (to align with our fiscal year), and 3) an SLA clause addition for guaranteed availability with a service credit tier at 99.5% uptime.

I know some of these are non-standard — can you let me know whether Pioneer MedTech could be accommodated and what concessions would look like in pricing / SOW? I've attached a redlined copy of the renewal MA they want to return.

Thanks,
Owen
Director of IT Operations
Pioneer MedTech

Attachment: Pioneer_Renewal_MA_final_redlines.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal options - Pioneer MedTech — exec signoff request

Team — forwarding Pioneer ask. Quick summary:
- Renewal date: 2026-07-15; ARR at stake: $675,000 annual commitment (deal DL-2026-0783).
- Customer asks: 15% one-time credit on Year 2 (approx $101k), 12-month term reset, and SLA language w/99.5% availability + service credit. They attached redlines.

Why escalate: Procurement is explicit that without contractual credit + SLA language they will not recommend renewal. Risk of churn is high; account has reference value in healthcare vertical.

My recommended concession package for exec approval:
1) One-time credit of 10% of ARR (=$67,500) applied as invoice credit on the Year 2 billing milestone (compromise vs their 15%).
2) Term reset to align to fiscal year (one-time only) — preserves our renewal cadence.
3) SLA addendum: 99.5% availability target with capped service credit limited to 5% of monthly invoice, only after remediation window and subject to force majeure carveouts.
4) Approve a 30-day no-cost ramp period for onboarding the new model variant they plan to use.

I'm asking for quick exec signoff on the above (or direction on which line items to push back on). 

Why my recommendation: balances commercial give with limits (credit smaller than requested, capped SLA credit). Finance and legal impact below.

Attachments: SOW_Pricing_Table.xlsx

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal options - Pioneer MedTech — exec signoff request

Thanks for the summary, Olga. From legal's perspective: the redlined SLA introduces broad "availability" obligations without clear measurement windows and removes key exclusions (scheduled maintenance, customer-induced incidents). We can accept an SLA addendum conditional on: 1) a clear measurement methodology (5-minute granularity, monthly measurement), 2) mutually agreed maintenance windows, and 3) caps on aggregated credits (max 5% monthly) and a dispute resolution pathway.

Term reset is operationally fine; we'll add clause that it doesn't impact termination rights or pricing bands for other customers. For the one-time credit, provide finance justification for the size (10% vs 15%) — we should treat it as a one-off retention concession tied to a 12-month irrevocable renewal commitment.

If we get finance sign-off on the 10% credit and exec buy-in, legal can produce a short SLA addendum and a one-time amendment within 48 hours.

- Rishi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal options - Pioneer MedTech — exec signoff request

I reviewed the numbers. Base case: retaining Pioneer yields $675k ARR and strong vertical reference; churn risk measurable. Approve a maximum one-time retention credit of 10% (=$67,500) on the condition that:
- Customer signs a 12-month irrevocable renewal at the new term start date;
- SLA credit cap is formalized at 5% monthly and requires an SLA measurement methodology;
- Any additional custom professional services or ramp work billed separately (we do NOT absorb beyond a 30-day no-cost ramp).

Finance will flag this as an exception to standard discount authority. We need an executive approval (VP/SVP) to proceed. If legal produces the SLA addendum within 48 hours and sales confirms the irrevocable renewal, finance will route the credit approval paperwork.

Vivek
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Owen Leary <owen.leary@pioneer-medtech.com>, Chelsea Park <chelsea@pioneer-medtech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: retention concession & SLA addendum for Pioneer MedTech (DL-2026-0783)

Hi Owen / Chelsea — and thanks for the candid note last week. We've discussed this with finance and legal and have the following one-time retention offer if Pioneer can sign the renewal by July 2 (to ensure continuity):

1) One-time invoice credit: 10% of Year 2 committed spend (credit = $67,500) applied on the first invoice after the new term starts.
2) Term reset: We will reset the contract term to a 12-month period aligned to your FY start (one-time only).
3) SLA addendum: Redwood will add a mutual SLA addendum with a 99.5% availability target. Service credit limited to 5% of monthly invoice, subject to defined measurement windows and mutually agreed maintenance windows; force majeure carved out. Legal will provide the addendum for signature within 48 hours upon your confirmation.
4) Ramp assistance: 30 days of onboarding support at no additional charge; additional professional services billed per standard rates.

If you can confirm acceptance by close of business on July 2 we will prepare the amendment and DocuSign package (link to follow). If these terms are acceptable we will also include a short addendum that explicitly states this concession is a one-time retention exception and not precedent-setting.

Appreciate the partnership — happy to hop on a quick call if you'd like to walk through the changes.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Attachment: SOW_Pricing_Table.xlsx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/drive/abcd-1234-pioneer-renewal
